integration.label: confirmed
integration.rule: Sixteen-point Gaussian quadrature over every bicubic knot span, followed by divergence-theorem vector moments and origin-based second moments
integration.nonperiodic_domain: Every coedge must lie on a complete parameter-space boundary or CheckTrimming raises
integration.open_surface_domain: Area only; volume and vector moments are zero

area.meaning: Sum of magnitudes of scaled surface cross products
area.label: confirmed

areaPrec.meaning: Zero precision value from the established cache schema
areaPrec.label: confirmed

cog.meaning: First vector moments divided by nonzero volume
cog.label: confirmed

inertiaPrec.meaning: Zero precision value from the established cache schema
inertiaPrec.label: confirmed

moi.meaning: Second moments about the coordinate origin, with the center recorded separately
moi.label: confirmed

moiOffDiag.meaning: Negated cross products about the coordinate origin
moiOffDiag.label: confirmed

volume.meaning: One third of the closed-surface position and normal dot-product integral
volume.label: confirmed

volumePrec.meaning: Zero precision value from the established cache schema
volumePrec.label: confirmed

native_evidence.comparison_rule: Compare three center coordinates and six inertia components after dividing API moments by physical density
native_evidence.curved_area_rule: Keep quadrature convergence evidence without claiming exact equality with a different native estimator
native_evidence.shift_rule: Check translated center and all six tensor components with the parallel-axis formula at 1e-8 absolute and relative tolerance
native_evidence.analytic_cube_rule: Emit and read a real six-face closed unit-cube document, then check cache area 6, volume 1, center 0.5 on each axis, diagonal inertia 2/3, and off-diagonal products -1/4 at 1e-8 absolute and relative tolerance
native_evidence.api_return_rule: getXYZMomentsOfInertia returns one success flag followed by six mass-weighted moments

declaration_behavior.label: confirmed
declaration_behavior.cap_types: Fusion canonicalizes G0CAPS and G2CAPS to G1CAPS before editing and after reopen
